svg.title: DON'T DROP IT! — B. C. Forest Service
svg.desc: A clean geometric reconstruction from the supplied historic-emblem image. Dark green circular field, cream double border, hand-built condensed display lettering, diagonal cigarette, looped smoke, and curved Forest Service credit. The original photographic texture and damaged edge are intentionally omitted. Illustration and headline are editable vector paths; no raster image or auto-trace is present. Footer lettering is outlined.
